dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Once this tree gets a bit larger, I'll cut its leaves down and make some tea for all of you."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "When that time comes, we'll get Cloud Retainer and Mountain Shaper to come over..."

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Seriously? You plant trees any way you like on my turf, and you have the nerve to spout such things?"

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: ...The day when the promises of yesteryear could be fulfilled arrived not, but the silent old tree still remembered the sound of that vow...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: ...Today, the aroma of tea has long since permeated Chenyu Vale and been carried to distant lands far beyond...
